source_revision: RM0456 Rev7 chapter63 and ES0499 Rev12 retained RTC RUN software reference
unknowns: Software-only reference. No PCB crystal route, fitted oscillator or physical station is asserted.

External boot owner must prepare and preserve LSE32768 crystal mode with LSEBYP=0 and LSEDRV=2/3, RTCEN/RTCAPBEN, PWREN/DBP, locked WPR with no competing writer, and valid BCD24h BYPSHAD PRER127/255 retained calendar before platform start.

ES0499 Rev12 2.2.3/16 affect revision X; this revision-unqualified software profile conservatively requires LSEBYP=0 and LSEDRV=2/3 without writing either field. External boot/Board owners exclude PC13 transitions on this LQFP part per section 2.2.1. LSE bypass is unaffected by section 2.2.1 and outside this selected profile.
Calendar provenance, including intentionally initialized YY00, is an external premise; INITS alone cannot establish it.
External boot owner owns PC14/PC15 oscillator resources. No selected GPIO owner may use those pads.
RUN polling only: no calendar set, calibration, backup reset, IRQ wake, Stop2, VBAT persistence or physical HIL qualification.

provenance.scope: Exact U575 RTC AlarmA/SCR layout, APB3 gate, AHB3 PWR gate, DBPR and BDCR; no PCB facts.
